officialApp.name: Ozlo Sleep
officialApp.notes: Android 12+ / iOS 17+ per Ozlo. Sleep sounds, modes, in-ear alarm, sleep sensing and (post-launch) sleep insights.

battery.chargingIndicators: Per-bud LEDs inside the Smart Case; case LEDs; app battery view for right bud, left bud and case.
battery.notes: Official: up to 10 h playback per bud; Smart Case holds an additional 32 h. The case is a powered Bluetooth bridge, so its level stays live while the buds are out. Case charges via USB-C.

anc.notes: No ANC. Passive silicone-tip isolation plus adaptive noise-masking audio; snoring is masked, not cancelled.

features.name: Sleep sounds and adaptive noise masking
features.notes: Sounds stored on the buds for phone-free playback.

features.name: Bluetooth audio streaming
features.notes: Streams any A2DP source; LE Audio used between case and buds.

features.name: Sleep detection and auto-switch to masking
Bluetooth-disabled phone-free mode
features.notes: Plays the stored sleep sound automatically when buds leave the case.

features.name: Smart Case environmental sensors
features.notes: Ambient noise, light and temperature sensing.

features.name: Sleep insights
features.notes: Sleep tracking/insights were listed as coming soon at launch and shipped through app updates; original-bud coverage not independently confirmed.

controls.notes: No controls on the buds and no case button on the first generation; everything is set in the Ozlo Sleep app.

audio.notes: Bluetooth Classic A2DP plus Bluetooth 5.3 LE Audio from the Smart Case. No microphone; not for calls.

sources.title: Ozlo Sleepbuds app on Google Play

gaps: Exact Bluetooth codec support beyond SBC/LE Audio not published.
Whether every first-generation unit received the later sleep-pattern features is not documented.
No official battery figure split between masking and streaming.
notes: First-generation Ozlo Sleepbuds, the team that acquired the Bose Sleepbuds technology. Distributed by Ozlo/Drowsy Digital.

officialApp.name: Ozlo Sleep
officialApp.notes: Adds Sleep Patterns, environmental insights, Blended Audio, custom audio tuning and Find My Sleepbud.

battery.chargingIndicators: Per-bud status LEDs; Smart Case LEDs; app shows right bud, left bud and case plus charging source.
battery.notes: Official: up to 14 h playback; Smart Case provides 2-3 additional charges (42 h at three charges). USB-C charging.

anc.notes: No ANC. Passive tips plus adaptive masking; Ozlo explicitly markets 'passive noise cancellation via silicone tips (not ANC)'.

features.name: 60+ sleep sounds and adaptive masking
features.notes: Auto-switches to masking when sleep is detected.

features.name: Bluetooth streaming (A2DP + LE Audio)
features.notes: Spotify, Calm, Audible, video and any other Bluetooth source.

features.name: Private in-ear alarm
features.notes: Runs from the buds without the phone.

features.name: Sleep Patterns tracking
features.notes: Duration, consistency and efficiency, using bud accelerometer plus case sensors.

features.name: Room noise, light and temperature insights
Smart Case button controls
features.notes: Start/pause sleep sound, snooze alarm and playback without the phone.

features.name: Bluetooth-disabled mode
features.notes: Stored sleep sound plays with radios off.

gestures.action: start/pause sleep sound, snooze alarm, playback

controls.physicalButtons: One multi-function button on the Smart Case; no controls on the buds
controls.notes: Designed for bedside use without opening the app.

audio.notes: Custom Audio Tuning and Blended Audio (mix streaming with sleep sound). No microphone; sleep-only device.

sources.title: Ozlo Sleepbuds app on Google Play

gaps: Case-to-buds radio is LE Audio; phone-side codec list beyond A2DP/LEA not published.
Number of case charges is stated as 2-3, not a single exact figure.
No official ANC or passive attenuation dB rating.
notes: Second-generation Ozlo Sleepbuds. Ozlo's own comparison table quotes the Soundcore A30 at 2.4 g / 10 h, which conflicts with Soundcore's 3 g / 9-10 h claims.
